description: Files_Upload is multipart/form-data with a required `purpose` field and the `file` part (the swagger models the body as a formData pair the converter drops), so the generated request carried only the endpoint and sent an empty JSON body. Send multipart with both members; `file` is a Document so a File keeps its filename (Azure validates the .jsonl extension).

traits.smithy.api#documentation: The intended purpose of the uploaded file: "fine-tune" for fine-tuning, "batch" for batch requests.
The file to upload: a File (its name is the uploaded filename, e.g. training.jsonl) or a Blob.
